channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Euro: Second hike seen as energy clouds outlook – Societe Generale
item.description: Societe Generale’s Kenneth Broux expects a second 25bp ECB depo rate hike, stressing that wage dynamics and updated staff forecasts will determine how far tightening goes.

item.title: Indian Rupee continues its underperformance amid surging oil prices
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) extends its losing run against the US Dollar (USD) for the third trading day on Thursday. The USD/INR pair posts a fresh 10-day high at 95.31 as the ongoing rally in oil prices continues to batter the Indian currency.

item.title: Euro remains steady vs Canadian Dollar ahead of key ECB decision
item.description: EUR/CAD trades around 1.6060 on Thursday at the time of writing, virtually unchanged on the day. The cross consolidates as investors refrain from taking large positions ahead of the European Central Bank’s (ECB) monetary policy decision, due at 12:15 GMT.

item.title: GBP/USD Price Forecast: Positions above 1.3550, nine-day EMA support
item.description: GBP/USD remains stronger for the fourth successive day, trading around 1.3550 during the European hours on Thursday. The pair is maintaining a modest bullish bias as it holds above both the nine- and 50-day Exponential Moving Averages (EMAs).

item.title: USD/JPY Price Forecast: Trades above 153.50 ahead of US inflation; bearish bias remains
item.description: The USD/JPY pair seesaws between tepid gains and minor losses through the first half of the European session on Thursday, consolidating its recent heavy losses to a nearly seven-month low, touched earlier this week.

item.title: Swiss Franc gives back gains, but US Dollar struggles with Inflation data on tap
item.description: The Swiss Franc (CHF) has given back previous daily gains against the US Dollar (USD) in a calm trading session on Thursday, as the USD/CHF pair returned above 0.8100, although it remains halfway through the weekly trading range.

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Consolidates around 1.1640 in countdown to ECB’s policy decision
item.description: The Euro (EUR) trades in a tight range at around 1.1640 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Thursday. The major currency pair consolidates as investors await the European Central Bank’s (ECB) monetary policy decision, which will be announced at 12:15 GMT.

item.title: Turkish Lira: Easing path and carry appeal – ING
item.description: ING’s Frantisek Taborsky expects the Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye (CBRT) to keep its policy rate at 37% for now, after normalising liquidity and lowering the effective funding rate.

item.title: Australian Dollar slips against Japanese Yen due to increased risk aversion
item.description: AUD/JPY extends its losing streak for the fourth consecutive day, trading around 110.70 during European hours on Thursday. The currency cross depreciates as the Australian Dollar (AUD) faces challenges amid escalating Middle East tensions that have weighed heavily on global risk sentiment.

item.title: Euro sticks to modest recovery gains vs Yen; remains close to YTD low ahead of ECB
item.description: The EUR/JPY cross struggles to capitalize on its modest intraday gains and trades around the 178.75 region during the first half of the European session on Thursday.

item.title: Swiss Franc: Range trading with limited momentum against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: UOB’s Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann keep a range-trading view on USD/CHF around 0.8100, after the pair held between 0.8065 and 0.8109 and closed near 0.8099. They now expect a slightly narrower 0.8060–0.8135 band to contain moves in the coming weeks.

item.title: Euro: Difficult path for gains against US Dollar – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Michael Pfister notes that markets fully price today’s ECB rate hike and see around 85 basis points of additional tightening by mid-2027, heavily driven by Oil dynamics.

item.title: Forex Today: ECB rate decision, US producer inflation data to lift volatility
item.description: Here is what you need to know on Thursday, September 10:

item.title: Dow Jones futures gain ahead of US PPI data
item.description: Dow Jones futures advance by 0.36% to trade above 52,600 during European hours on Thursday. Meanwhile, S&P 500 futures gain by 0.22% to trade above 7,650, while Nasdaq 100 futures inch lower by 0.04% to trade near 29,430.

item.title: NZD/USD Price Forecast: Bears remain in control with 0.5800 support eyed
item.description: The New Zealand Dollar (NZD) nudges higher against a depressed US Dollar (USD) on Thursday, but keeps its near-term bearish trend intact as high Oil prices and surging global yields keep market sentiment subdued.

item.title: European Central Bank to resume interest rate hikes in September as inflation, energy risks rise
item.description: The European Central Bank (ECB) is expected to raise the interest rate on the Main Refinancing Operations and the Deposit Facility by 25 basis points (bps) to 2.65% and 2.50%, respectively. The ECB will announce the decision on Thursday at 12:15 GMT.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Structural support from regional flows – BNY
item.description: BNY’s Geoff Yu notes that Japanese Yen (JPY) strength is reshaping APAC (Asia-Pacific) FX dynamics by easing prior effective exchange rate pressures and allowing more nominal appreciation in regional currencies.

item.title: Australian Dollar struggles for direction against US Dollar with US PPI in focus
item.description: The Australian Dollar (AUD) trades in a tight range at around 0.7215 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Thursday.

item.title: US Dollar Index Price Forecast: Holds losses below 99.00 as bearish bias prevails
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, is losing ground for the fourth successive day and trading around 98.70 during the European hours on Thursday.

item.title: Gold holds steady above $4,400 as traders await US inflation data for Fed rate cues
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) struggles to capitalize on a modest intraday uptick on Thursday and trades just above the $4,400 mark during the early European session. Moreover, the commodity holds comfortably above a one-week low, set on Wednesday, as traders keenly await the release of US inflation figures.

item.title: European Central Bank: Higher energy lifts rate hike expectations – Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank reports that rising Oil and natural gas prices are pushing European yields to multi‑year highs and prompting markets to price a more hawkish European Central Bank path.

item.title: WTI falls below $93.50 on profit-taking, continued US-Iran tensions in focus
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI), the US crude oil benchmark, is trading around $93.20 during the early European trading hours on Thursday. WTI falls as traders book some profits.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD awaits acceptance above $68.00 before the next leg up
item.description: Silver (XAG/USD) struggles to capitalize on a modest intraday uptick to the $68.00 neighborhood and trades near the lower end of its daily range during the early European session on Thursday.

item.title: Indonesian Rupiah faces challenges due to higher oil prices
item.description: USD/IDR gains after two days of losses, trading around 17,570 during the early European hours on Thursday. The pair gains upward momentum as the Indonesian Rupiah (IDR) faces pressure from elevated oil prices, which strain fiscal conditions given Indonesia's status as a net oil importer.

item.title: Euro wavers around 0.8590 against British Pound with all eyes on the ECB
item.description: The Euro (EUR) is trading sideways in a 15-pip range, roughly between 0.8580 and 0.8595 against the British Pound (GBP) on Thursday.

item.title: Equities: Stagflation pattern weighs on stocks – Danske Bank
item.description: Danske Research Team reports that global equities fell as higher energy prices, rising bond yields and a smaller-than-hoped US Treasury buyback weighed on sentiment.

item.title: British Pound: Neutral stance inside narrower band against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: UOB’s Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann keep a neutral view on GBP/USD around 1.3545, noting recent sideways trade between 1.3531 and 1.3567. They now see a tighter 1.3495–1.3590 range as sufficient to contain price action.

item.title: British Pound moves away from YTD low as Yen consolidates hawkish BoJ-inspired rally
item.description: The GBP/JPY cross gains some positive traction on Thursday and moves away from the year-to-date low, around the 207.00 neighborhood, touched earlier this week. Spot prices stick to modest gains above the 208.00 mark through the early European session, though the uptick lacks bullish conviction.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Intervention risk supports against US Dollar – Commerzbank
item.description: Michael Pfister highlights that comments from the US Treasury Secretary about having “asymmetric information” on Bank of Japan (BoJ) moves are intended to deter speculative positioning for further Japanese Yen (JPY) weakness.

item.title: USD/CAD Price Forecast: Wobbles around 1.3800 ahead of US PPI data
item.description: The Canadian Dollar (CAD) trades sideways at around 1.3810 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Thursday. The Loonie pair consolidates as investors await the United States (US) Producer Price Index (PPI) data for August, which will be published at 12:30 GMT.
